description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stone-Giant of High Pass, adding {C}{C}.
When Stone-Giant of High Pass dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Stone-Giant of High Pass from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Stone-Giant of High Pass enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
